run_traffic_analysis: run traffic flow analysis on a video using YOLO detection, ByteTrack tracking, and polygon zone counting
create_polygon_zones: create polygon zones from numpy arrays for detecting objects entering or exiting defined areas
build_video_processor: build a video processor that annotates frames with bounding boxes, traces, and labels while tracking objects across zones
manage_detections: manage detection counts by tracking objects entering and exiting polygon zones with unique tracker IDs
annotate_video_frames: annotate video frames with polygon zones, bounding boxes, traces, and zone crossing counts
